collar_tag_req: All dogs within the Village must be licensed in accordance with By-law No. 8 of 95... If the dog is identified through its dog tag, the owner will be contacted.
notes: Full bylaw text not available online, but municipal website confirms licensing requirements under By-law No. 8 of 95. No mention of agricultural or working dog exemptions on the summary page. URL: https://www.villageofpointedward.com/community-services/animal-control

collar_tag_req: As per the Town's Dog Licensing By-law (By-law 129 of 2024) all dogs in the municipality must be licenced.
dog_limit: You can have up to three dogs per house in a residential area.
notes: Standard animal control bylaw. No specific agricultural exemptions for working dogs mentioned in the municipal summary. URL: https://www.plympton-wyoming.com/my-plympton-wyoming/animal-control-services/

collar_tag_req: Dog and cat tags are mandatory in the Town of Petawawa. We've partnered with DocuPet to provide a simple and secure way to license your pet online.
notes: Full by-law text not publicly accessible online. The town uses DocuPet for mandatory tags. No agricultural exemptions mentioned. URL: https://petawawa.ca/living-here/animal-control/

collar_tag_req: Every owner of a dog upon becoming a resident of the Township of Ryerson, or upon becoming the owner of a dog, shall obtain a license and register each dog... The owner shall not use the dog tag upon a dog other than the one for which it was issued.
dog_limit: No owner or owners living at the same address shall keep more than four (4) dogs in any one household over the age of twelve (12) weeks.
notes: Standard animal control bylaw. Contains kennel licensing provisions but no specific definitions or exemptions for livestock guardian dogs. URL: https://www.ryersontownship.ca/content/town-hall/bylaws/by-law-25-25-animal-control-by-law.pdf

collar_tag_req: The Town of Renfrew, requires that all dogs and cats must be licensed and wearing a tag.
dog_limit: The Town by-laws also state there shall be no more than four (4) animals per household at any one time.
notes: Service dogs are explicitly exempt from the cost of licensing, but there are no specific farm dog or LGD exemptions mentioned. URL: https://www.renfrew.ca/en/animals

BYLAW NOT FOUND. The municipal website mentions pet owners are required to license their animals within 6 months, but the actual by-law name or document is not available online. URL: https://redrocktownship.com/services/licenses-animal-lottery/

collar_tag_req: Every owner shall procure a tag for each dog or cat owned and shall keep the tag affixed to the dog or cat for which it was procured at all times during the year and until such time as he procures a tag for each dog or cat for the following year.
dog_limit: Keep more than 4 dogs on premises (fineable offense).
notes: Standard animal care and control by-law. URL: https://saultstemarie.ca/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/2019-117-Animal-Care-and-Control-Consolidated_1.pdf

collar_tag_req: The owner of every dog shall keep the dog tag, provided by the Town, securely fixed on such dog at all times until the tag is renewed or replaced.
dog_limit: No person shall keep or permit to be kept at any one time on any one property no more than four (4) dogs, excluding dogs three (3) months of age or less.
notes: Standard by-law with no specific agricultural exemptions for farm dogs or LGDs. URL: https://www.shelburne.ca/media/vajoeum4/animal-control-by-law-15-2018-shelburne.pdf

collar_tag_req: Animal Control and Pound Services are provided by the Peterborough Humane Society and the fees raised by Dog Licencing are used to offset the cost of this service to the Township of Selwyn.
notes: Full by-law text not fully accessible online (only consolidated appendices and articles were available). URL: https://www.selwyntownship.ca/living-here/animal-control/
